review: 702.19c-1: the blocked variant added Grizzly Bears to B's battlefield and also declared it as a blocker; put Grizzly Bears on B's battlefield in the base setup (not blocking) so the variant changes only the block declaration.

702.19e-1: the blocked variant added Grizzly Bears to B's battlefield and also declared it as a blocker; put Grizzly Bears on B's battlefield in the base setup (not blocking) so the variant changes only the block declaration.

702.19f-1: planeswalker_stays was labelled does_not_fire although 702.19f still applies there (no damage reaches B), and no variant made the rule's effect fail; relabelled planeswalker_stays fires and added a trample_over_planeswalkers variant (Thrasta instead of Craw Wurm, 7 damage to B) as the does_not_fire branch.

scenarios.title: Trample only matters while the creature is attacking
decisions: A attacks player B with Colossal Dreadmaw.
B blocks Colossal Dreadmaw with Grizzly Bears.
A assigns 2 damage to Grizzly Bears and 4 damage to player B.
No spells or abilities are used; combat damage is dealt.

variants.label: trampler_attacks
variants.expected: Grizzly Bears is destroyed by 2 damage. B takes 4 trample damage (life 16). Colossal Dreadmaw takes 2 damage and survives.

variants.label: trampler_blocks
variants.delta: The roles are reversed: B controls Colossal Dreadmaw and blocks with it, and A attacks with Grizzly Bears (no summoning sickness).
variants.expected: Colossal Dreadmaw deals all 6 damage to Grizzly Bears, which is destroyed. A's life stays 20. Colossal Dreadmaw takes 2 damage and survives. No damage goes to either player.

scenarios.forge_notes: In the second variant the harness fixes the attacker and blocker declarations for the swapped sides.

scenarios.title: A trampling attacker assigns lethal damage to its blockers and the excess to the defending player
decisions: A attacks player B with Colossal Dreadmaw.
B blocks Colossal Dreadmaw with Grizzly Bears.
A assigns the maximum possible damage to player B: lethal damage to each blocker and the rest to B.
No spells or abilities are used; combat damage is dealt.

variants.label: trample
variants.expected: Grizzly Bears (2 toughness) receives 2 damage and is destroyed. B takes the 4 excess damage (life 16).

variants.label: no_trample
variants.delta: A's attacker is Craw Wurm (6/4, no trample) instead of Colossal Dreadmaw.
variants.expected: Craw Wurm assigns all 6 damage to Grizzly Bears, which is destroyed. B's life stays 20.

variants.label: toughness_matches_power
variants.delta: B's blocker is a Colossal Dreadmaw (6 toughness) instead of Grizzly Bears.
variants.expected: A's Colossal Dreadmaw assigns all 6 damage to the blocking Colossal Dreadmaw as lethal damage, and none to B (life 20). Both Colossal Dreadmaws are destroyed.

variants.label: damage_already_marked
variants.delta: Grizzly Bears already has 1 damage marked, so lethal damage is 1.
variants.expected: Grizzly Bears receives 1 damage and is destroyed. B takes 5 damage (life 15).

variants.label: two_blockers
variants.delta: B blocks with two Grizzly Bears instead of one.
variants.expected: Each Grizzly Bears receives 2 damage and is destroyed. B takes the 2 excess damage (life 18).

scenarios.forge_notes: The damage assignment must be fixed by the harness. The second Grizzly Bears of the two_blockers variant is a second copy of the same card.

scenarios.title: Trample over planeswalkers lets excess damage beyond the planeswalker's loyalty reach its controller

setup.notes: Thrasta has been on the battlefield since an earlier turn, so it has no hexproof.

decisions: A attacks Jace Beleren with Thrasta, Tempest's Roar.
B declares no blockers (Grizzly Bears does not block).
A assigns 3 damage to Jace Beleren and 4 damage to player B.
No spells or abilities are used; combat damage is dealt.

variants.label: trample_over_planeswalkers
variants.expected: Jace Beleren is dealt 3 damage, loses all loyalty and goes to B's graveyard. B takes 4 damage (life 16).

variants.label: plain_trample
variants.delta: A's attacker is Colossal Dreadmaw (6/6, trample but not trample over planeswalkers) instead of Thrasta, and A assigns all 6 damage to Jace Beleren.
variants.expected: Jace Beleren is dealt 6 damage and goes to B's graveyard. B's life stays 20: Colossal Dreadmaw cannot assign damage to B.

variants.label: blocked
variants.delta: B blocks Thrasta with Grizzly Bears; A assigns 2 damage to Grizzly Bears, 3 to Jace Beleren and 2 to player B.
variants.expected: Grizzly Bears is destroyed. Jace Beleren is dealt 3 damage and goes to B's graveyard. B takes 2 damage (life 18).

scenarios.forge_notes: Thrasta carries both Trample and Trample:Planeswalker in Forge, matching the Oracle text. The damage assignment must be fixed by the harness.

scenarios.title: A blocked trampler whose blocker has left combat assigns all its damage to the defending player
decisions: A attacks player B with Colossal Dreadmaw.
B blocks Colossal Dreadmaw with Grizzly Bears.
In the declare blockers step A casts Lightning Bolt targeting Grizzly Bears, tapping Mountain; both players pass and it resolves, destroying Grizzly Bears.
A assigns all 6 damage to player B.
No further spells or abilities are used; combat damage is dealt.

variants.label: trampler_no_blockers_left
variants.expected: Colossal Dreadmaw stays blocked but has no blocker, and deals all 6 damage to B (life 14). Grizzly Bears is in B's graveyard.

variants.label: no_trample
variants.delta: A's attacker is Craw Wurm (6/4, no trample) instead of Colossal Dreadmaw.
variants.expected: Craw Wurm is blocked and has no blocker, so it deals no combat damage. B's life stays 20. Grizzly Bears is in B's graveyard.

scenarios.forge_notes: In the second variant Craw Wurm's summoning sickness is also cleared.

scenarios.title: A trample-over-planeswalkers attacker whose planeswalker left combat deals its damage to the defending player

setup.notes: Thrasta has been on the battlefield since an earlier turn, so it has no hexproof.

decisions: A attacks Jace Beleren with Thrasta, Tempest's Roar.
B declares no blockers (Grizzly Bears does not block).
In the declare blockers step B casts Lightning Bolt targeting Jace Beleren, tapping Mountain; both players pass and it resolves, destroying Jace Beleren.
A assigns all 7 damage to player B.
No further spells or abilities are used; combat damage is dealt.

variants.label: unblocked
variants.expected: Jace Beleren is in B's graveyard. Thrasta deals all 7 damage to B (life 13).

variants.label: blocked
variants.delta: B blocks Thrasta with Grizzly Bears; A assigns 2 damage to Grizzly Bears and 5 to player B.
variants.expected: Grizzly Bears is destroyed. B takes 5 damage (life 15). Jace Beleren is in B's graveyard.

variants.label: plain_trample
variants.delta: A's attacker is Colossal Dreadmaw (6/6, trample but not trample over planeswalkers) instead of Thrasta.
variants.expected: Colossal Dreadmaw deals no combat damage to B (life 20) because it can only assign damage to the planeswalker that left the battlefield. Jace Beleren is in B's graveyard.

scenarios.forge_notes: Forge may treat an attacker whose planeswalker has left the battlefield as removed from combat (dealing no damage at all) rather than as attacking nothing; the base and blocked variants need the 702.19e exception to be implemented.

scenarios.title: A creature without trample over planeswalkers never deals combat damage to the defending player for attacking a planeswalker
decisions: A attacks Jace Beleren with Craw Wurm.
B declares no blockers.
In the declare blockers step B casts Lightning Bolt targeting Jace Beleren, tapping Mountain; both players pass and it resolves, destroying Jace Beleren.
No further spells or abilities are used; combat damage is dealt.

variants.label: planeswalker_removed
variants.expected: Jace Beleren is in B's graveyard. Craw Wurm deals no combat damage and B's life stays 20.

variants.label: trample_over_planeswalkers
variants.delta: A's attacker is Thrasta, Tempest's Roar (7/7, trample over planeswalkers) instead of Craw Wurm.
variants.expected: Jace Beleren is in B's graveyard. Thrasta deals all 7 combat damage to B (life 13).

variants.label: planeswalker_stays
variants.delta: B does not cast Lightning Bolt, and Jace Beleren stays on the battlefield.
variants.expected: Craw Wurm deals 6 damage to Jace Beleren, which loses all loyalty and goes to B's graveyard. B's life stays 20: the excess over the loyalty is not dealt to B.

variants.label: attacks_player
variants.delta: A attacks player B instead of Jace Beleren, and B does not cast Lightning Bolt.
variants.expected: Craw Wurm deals 6 damage to B (life 14). Jace Beleren stays at 3 loyalty.

scenarios.forge_notes: Forge may treat an attacker whose planeswalker has left the battlefield as removed from combat; either way it deals no damage to B. In the trample_over_planeswalkers variant Thrasta has been on the battlefield since an earlier turn.
